mission.briefing: Two enemy squads have strayed into our training ground. Destroy them before day 8.

hints.text: Tap one of your units to see where it can go (white) and what it could hit (red).
Tap a white tile to move there, then choose Fire and tap a target, or Wait.
The forecast shows the damage you deal and what comes back. Hurt units hit softer.
Forests and mountains protect whoever stands on them.

guide.text: This is your tank. Tap it to see where it can go.
White tiles: where it can move. Red: what it could hit from there. Tap a white tile, then choose Wait (the enemy is too far to hit this turn).
Now your infantry. Tap it, tap a tile toward the enemy, and choose Wait.
Units that have moved turn grey. When you are done, end your turn.
The enemy moves. When one of your units can reach an enemy, tap a tile next to it and choose Fire, then tap the enemy. The forecast shows the damage.
That is all there is to fighting. Destroy both squads before day 8. Forests and mountains give cover.
